<?php

function funkyNumbers($n) {
    $funkyNumber = 'NO';
    $maxTriangle = maxTrianglePossible($n);

    for ($i = $maxTriangle; $i > 0; $i--) {
        $firstTriangle = triangleNumbers($i);
        $rem = $n - $firstTriangle;

        if ($rem === 0) continue;

        $secFactor = maxTrianglePossible($rem);
        $secTriangle = triangleNumbers($secFactor);

        $triangles = $firstTriangle + $secTriangle;

        if ($triangles == $n) {
            $funkyNumber = 'YES';
            break;
        }
    }

    return $funkyNumber;
}

function maxTrianglePossible($n) {
    $k = floor(sqrt($n * 2));
    return $k;
}

function triangleNumbers($x) {
    $f = ($x * ($x + 1)) / 2;
    return $f;
}

$handle = fopen("php://stdin", "r");
$line = fgets($handle);
fclose($handle);

$n = trim($line);
$res = funkyNumbers((int)$n);
echo $res . PHP_EOL;
